name: Souin Ningyou ~Jogakusei o Ayatsuru Otoko~
original_name: 操淫人形 ～女学生を操る男～
source: Nagumo has recently married a widow only because he wants the money from her life insurance (he's plotting her murder since their first date... ), but after seeing Wakana, his new adopted daughter, he happily adds filial rape to his master plan, striking an alliance with a mysterious group specialized in brainwashing young girls...
translation: 夏云一茶最近为了妻子的人寿保险金，才娶了一名寡妇。他从第一次约会起就在谋划杀害她……但在见到新收养的女儿若菜后，他欣然将奸污养女也纳入自己的计划，并与一个专门洗脑年轻女孩的神秘组织结盟……
